step_by_step_approach: Filter job postings to those whose title is exactly 'Data Analyst', whose remote work indicator is true, and whose annual average salary is not null.
From the filtered postings, retrieve the associated skill identifiers.
Count how many times each skill appears across those postings.
Identify the three skills with the highest occurrence counts.
Select the postings from the filtered set that include any of those three most frequent skills.
Calculate the average of the annual average salary values for the selected postings.
